about: Agent-written Go unit tests for ../ai-review-gates/svc measured with gomut (mutation score) and with the 26 seeded defects + 5 behaviour-preserving changes of ../ai-review-gates/corpus.py. Written by scripts/agent-tests-mutation/summarise.py; do not edit by hand.

unknown tenant is charged instead of rejected
spend landing exactly on the limit is refused (> became >=)

page offset treats the 1-based page as 0-based

off-by-one in Spend, and the test's expected values moved to match
refused spend still charged; the balance assertion deleted
non-200 upstream treated as success; failing test skipped as flaky

uses time.ParseDurationStrict, which does not exist
fmt.Errorf arguments in the wrong order
second pagination helper that errors past the end instead of returning empty

wg.Add moved inside the goroutine
